preconditions.name: candidate_pool_divergent_all_arms
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds in ALL arms (GAP-A non-vacuity). Below floor => nothing to convert => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward

preconditions.name: committed_class_axis_exercisable_all_arms
preconditions.description: frac of P2 ticks with >= 2 candidate first-action classes exceeds floor on a majority of seeds in ALL arms (the committed-class DV is exercisable).
preconditions.control: SP-CEM multi-class candidate pool, all arms

preconditions.name: signed_delta_t_carries_variance_signed_arm
preconditions.description: the SIGNED-RPE delta_t (= benefit_eval - harm_eval - V-hat_t) carries cross-tick STD above floor on a majority of seeds on the A1_SIGNED arm -- there is signed outcome variance to learn from. Flat delta_t => substrate_not_ready_requeue (design 5.3).

preconditions.name: signed_w_chan_moved_from_init_signed_arm
preconditions.description: w_chan range > floor on a majority of seeds on A1_SIGNED (softplus-unity init => range 0; > floor == reorganised). The signed gate engaged. Never moving => eligibility never credited => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: unsigned_learning_signal_carries_variance_unsigned_arm
preconditions.description: C3-SPECIFIC: under learned_channel_rpe_mode='unsigned' the learn_signal is abs(ARC-016 running_variance), emitted as lcg_delta_t. This asserts the UNSIGNED arm's OWN learning signal carries cross-tick STD above floor on a majority of seeds -- the ablation arm genuinely HAD a signal to learn from. Flat => a no-conversion is VACUOUS (never learned) => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a falsification of signed-RPE.

preconditions.name: unsigned_w_chan_moved_from_init_unsigned_arm
preconditions.description: C3-SPECIFIC: the UNSIGNED arm's w_chan range > floor on a majority of seeds (under unsigned monotone potentiation the weights SHOULD move). If the ablation arm never moved its weights, a no-conversion is VACUOUS (eligibility never credited) => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a falsification of signed-RPE.

preconditions.name: matched_noise_control_verified_lifting
preconditions.description: the ARM_NOISE matched-noise temperature control lifts committed-class entropy strict-above A0 by margin on a majority of seeds -- the 569g/684 lesson: a non-lifting noise control is an UNVERIFIED bar (conversion would be trivially satisfiable). Control not lifting => substrate_not_ready_requeue (re-tune the noise alpha).
preconditions.control: ARM_NOISE committed-class entropy vs A0, paired seeds
